about: Views the visual check watches (tools/check/visual.py). width: render width in px for the whole scene, about 300 dpi on the largest print, capped at 12000. Crops: x, y, w, h in render px.

views.name: richmond-i195-rocketts
views.why: RVA-09, The James, I-195 to Rocketts Landing: 10 x 24 in, the whole width; 24 in at 300 dpi = 7,200 px.

crops.name: fall-line-hills
crops.why: Steep wooded bluffs at the west end and the I-195 bridge: hillshade, contours, bridge piers.

crops.name: open-park
crops.why: Open ground on the north bank: park fill, paths, gentle slopes and contours.

crops.name: downtown-bridges
crops.why: Downtown towers over the river and the Manchester and Mayo bridges: buildings, occlusion, decks.

crops.name: rocketts-end
crops.why: The Rocketts end: the rail viaduct, the river channel, tanks and treatment basins, and the plate's near edge (slab).

views.name: richmond-downtown
views.why: Not a sold piece; flat (no terrain). Watched for buildings and bridges on flat ground at 6,000 px.

crops.name: bridges
crops.why: Bridges over the river: decks, piers, rails and ramps.

crops.name: towers
crops.why: Tall downtown towers: walls, roofs and what they hide.

crops.name: east-riverfront
crops.why: Dense low buildings, rail and the riverfront at the east edge.

views.name: richmond-downtown-time-1925
views.why: RVA-01, Richmond, 1925: 24 x 36 in, the print's box is 4,524 of the scene's 6,048 units; 36 in at 300 dpi would be 14,400 px for the scene, capped at 12,000.

crops.name: title
crops.why: The year and title lettering at the top left (the dated scene's title).

crops.name: church-hill-bluff
crops.why: Steep bluff below Church Hill: hillshade steps and traced Sanborn buildings on the slope.

crops.name: river-bridges
crops.why: The 1925 viaducts, traced riverfront buildings, the river's islands and its rocks (dots).

crops.name: dense-traced
crops.why: Dense traced Sanborn buildings: many small footprints, heights and order.

views.name: richmond-downtown-time-2026
views.why: RVA-05, Richmond, 2026: same print and width as 1925.

crops.name: towers
crops.why: Downtown towers today: tall walls, roofs and occlusion.

crops.name: interchange
crops.why: The I-95 and rail interchange by the river: stacked bridge decks and piers.

crops.name: rowhouses-terrain
crops.why: Dense rowhouses on sloping ground: many small buildings with hillshade.

views.name: gwynns-island
views.why: GWY-01, Gwynn's Island: 24 x 36 in, the print's box is 8,500 of 19,574 units, so 300 dpi would need 24,900 px; capped at 12,000 (about 145 dpi on the print).

crops.name: island-village
crops.why: Houses and roads on Gwynn's Island: Microsoft footprints, small buildings, shoreline.

crops.name: bridge
crops.why: The bridge to the island and the narrow water around it.

crops.name: steep-shore
crops.why: The steepest ground in the view, on the Piankatank's north shore: hillshade and contours.

crops.name: open-woods
crops.why: Open ground: land cover fills (woods, fields) and their texture.

views.name: broad-street-station-front-1943
views.why: BSS box 15, Broad Street Station (the 1943 front, modeled station and platforms): a box print is 24 x 18 in over 250 m, about 2,825 of 3,438 units; 24 in at 300 dpi gives 8,800 px.

crops.name: title
crops.why: The year and title lettering.

crops.name: portico
crops.why: The modeled station's portico, columns and dome: parts, shading, edges (a broken portico was once published).

crops.name: platforms
crops.why: Platform canopies, tracks and trains east of the station.

crops.name: lawn-hillshade
crops.why: Open lawns, roads and the 2 m hillshade south of the tracks: blocky shading shows here first.

views.name: lm-eiffel-tower
views.why: LMW-01, Eiffel Tower: 36 x 24 in landscape over a 5,977-unit window of 6,048; 36 in at 300 dpi gives 10,900 px.

crops.name: tower
crops.why: The tower from base to top: the lattice spire's edges and any stray dots on it.

crops.name: bridges-river
crops.why: The Pont d'Iena and the Seine: bridge decks, piers and water.

crops.name: trocadero-slope
crops.why: The Trocadero slope: hillshade on steep ground, park fill and paths.

crops.name: dense-blocks
crops.why: Dense Paris blocks: courtyards, roofs, many small walls.
